title: Wire substrate selection into agent-runner.md and SKILL.md
description:
Edit skills/ticks/references/agent-runner.md and skills/ticks/SKILL.md: introduce the substrate concept (harness adapter chooses WHO orchestrates; substrate chooses HOW workers are dispatched), add the herdr detection probe (HERDR_ENV=1 / socket) alongside harness detection, document the runners.toml substrate setting and the auto/fallback rule (herdr when available unless configured otherwise; explicit degradation message when herdr requested but absent), and link herdr-runner.md from the adapter table. Keep the four harness adapters authoritative for harness-native dispatch - this is additive routing, not replacement.
Test: a fresh-session read of SKILL.md + agent-runner.md yields an unambiguous decision procedure for (harness, substrate) in all four combinations of in/out of herdr x configured herdr/harness/auto.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter table lists herdr substrate; detection order and fallback documented; no contradiction with existing adapter selection text
